name: World Monitor
description: World Monitor is a real-time global intelligence dashboard. It combines AI-powered news aggregation, geopolitical monitoring and infrastructure tracking in one interface.

notes.text: Public data sources work out of the box. For more feeds, add API keys (Groq, OpenRouter, Finnhub, FRED, NASA FIRMS and others) to /opt/worldmonitor/.env and restart worldmonitor and worldmonitor-ais-relay.
For AI assessments, point LLM_API_URL, LLM_API_KEY and LLM_MODEL in /opt/worldmonitor/.env at any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (Ollama, vLLM, llama.cpp).
